mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `stock_prediction` WHERE `asof_date` = #{asof} AND `horizon` = #{horizon} AND `model_id` = #{modelId}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `model_registry` WHERE `horizon` = #{horizon}) AS `modelTotal`, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `model_registry` WHERE `horizon` = #{horizon} AND `status` = 'champion') AS `championCount`, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `model_registry` WHERE `horizon` = #{horizon} AND `status` = 'candidate') AS `candidateCount`, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `model_registry` WHERE `horizon` = #{horizon} AND `status` = 'retired') AS `retiredCount`, (SELECT AVG(t.`rank_ic`) FROM ( SELECT e.`rank_ic`, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.`model_id` ORDER BY e.`asof_date` DESC) AS rn FROM `model_eval` e JOIN `model_registry` r ON r.`model_id` = e.`model_id` WHERE e.`horizon` = #{horizon} AND r.`status` IN ('champion','candidate') ) t WHERE t.`rn` <= 60) AS `avgRankIc60`

SELECT r.`model_id` AS `modelId`, r.`model_type` AS `modelType`, r.`horizon` AS `horizon`, r.`label_def` AS `labelDef`, r.`feature_version` AS `featureVersion`, r.`train_start` AS `trainStart`, r.`train_end` AS `trainEnd`, r.`status` AS `status`, r.`note` AS `note`, r.`created_at` AS `createdAt`, s.`avgRankIc60` AS `avgRankIc60`, s.`icir60` AS `icir60`, s.`avgTopnExcess` AS `avgTopnExcess`, s.`evalCount` AS `evalCount` FROM `model_registry` r LEFT JOIN ( SELECT `model_id`, AVG(`rank_ic`) AS `avgRankIc60`, AVG(`rank_ic`) / NULLIF(STDDEV_SAMP(`rank_ic`), 0) AS `icir60`, AVG(`topn_avg_excess`) AS `avgTopnExcess`, COUNT(*) AS `evalCount` FROM ( SELECT `model_id`, `rank_ic`, `topn_avg_excess`, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY `model_id` ORDER BY `asof_date` DESC) AS rn FROM `model_eval` WHERE `horizon` = #{horizon} ) t WHERE t.`rn` <= 60 GROUP BY `model_id` ) s ON s.`model_id` = r.`model_id` WHERE r.`horizon` = #{horizon} ORDER BY FIELD(r.`status`, 'champion', 'candidate', 'retired'), s.`icir60` DESC

SELECT p.`code` AS `code`, p.`market` AS `market`, i.`name` AS `name`, i.`industry` AS `industry`, p.`prob_up` AS `probUp`, p.`pred_ret` AS `predRet`, p.`pred_q10` AS `predQ10`, p.`pred_q90` AS `predQ90`, p.`score` AS `score`, p.`rank_all` AS `rankAll`, (o.`code` IS NOT NULL) AS `outcomeFilled`, o.`entry_tradable` AS `entryTradable`, o.`real_ret` AS `realRet`, o.`excess_ret` AS `excessRet` FROM `stock_prediction` p LEFT JOIN `stock_info` i ON i.`code` = p.`code` LEFT JOIN `prediction_outcome` o ON o.`code` = p.`code` AND o.`market` = p.`market` AND o.`asof_date` = p.`asof_date` AND o.`horizon` = #{horizon} WHERE p.`asof_date` = #{asof} AND p.`horizon` = #{horizon} AND p.`model_id` = #{modelId} AND p.`is_selected` = 1 ORDER BY p.`rank_all` ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.`code` AS `code`, p.`market` AS `market`, i.`name` AS `name`, p.`prob_up` AS `probUp`, p.`pred_ret` AS `predRet`, p.`score` AS `score`, p.`rank_all` AS `rankAll`, p.`is_selected` AS `isSelected` FROM `stock_prediction` p LEFT JOIN `stock_info` i ON i.`code` = p.`code` WHERE p.`asof_date` = #{asof} AND p.`horizon` = #{horizon} AND p.`model_id` = #{modelId} ORDER BY p.`rank_all` ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT `model_id` AS `modelId`, `asof_date` AS `asofDate`, `horizon` AS `horizon`, `n_samples` AS `nSamples`, `ic` AS `ic`, `rank_ic` AS `rankIc`, `auc` AS `auc`, `brier` AS `brier`, `topn_hit_rate` AS `topnHitRate`, `topn_avg_ret` AS `topnAvgRet`, `topn_avg_excess` AS `topnAvgExcess`, `all_avg_ret` AS `allAvgRet`, `decile_spread` AS `decileSpread` FROM `model_eval` WHERE `horizon` = #{horizon} AND `model_id` = #{modelId} ORDER BY `asof_date` DESC, `model_id` ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT w.`asof_date` AS `asofDate`, w.`horizon` AS `horizon`, w.`model_id` AS `modelId`, w.`weight` AS `weight`, w.`icir_60` AS `icir60` FROM `model_weight` w JOIN (SELECT MAX(`asof_date`) AS d FROM `model_weight` WHERE `horizon` = #{horizon}) t ON w.`asof_date` = t.d WHERE w.`horizon` = #{horizon} ORDER BY w.`weight` DESC
SELECT DISTINCT `asof_date` FROM `prediction_run` ORDER BY `asof_date` DESC LIMIT #{limit}
